name: Axiom Ax-4
about: Axiom Ax-4 (2025-136A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon 2), launched 2025 Jun 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2025 Jun 25), held fixed
docked to A09460; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
